title: Communal polarization intensifies after Calcutta killings
detail: The aftermath of the Great Calcutta Killing contributed to rising fear, rumor, and retaliatory sentiment across Bengal and beyond.

title: Large-scale violence erupts in Noakhali region
detail: In parts of Noakhali and adjacent areas, communal attacks resulted in killings, displacement, and severe social disruption.

title: Relief, peace missions, and political contest over narrative
detail: Public leaders and activists attempted relief and reconciliation efforts while rival political camps framed the events to support competing constitutional claims.

title: Noakhali becomes a partition-era reference point
detail: The memory of Noakhali fed reciprocal insecurity and was repeatedly invoked in arguments about separation during partition negotiations.
